subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The companies were / giving in the prizes / to attract customers / during the festive season.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the preposition "**in**" in the phrase "**giving in the prizes**."
 
• The correct preposition to use with the verb "**give**" in this context is "**away**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**giving away the prizes**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The companies were **giving away__ the prizes** to attract customers during the festive season."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "to attract customers,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "during the festive season,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "The companies were,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
